reason: The order excuses the listed society members from duty so that they may take part in the parade in connection with the removal of the body of the Vice-President; its text states "Vice-President Clinton on Wednesday, May 27, 1908, be excused from". The excusal therefore ran to May 27, 1908, recorded inclusive (it covers that whole day); the exclusive reading is that it ends when that day begins.

EO 1093 of 1909-06-21 authorizes reinstating the same person, Miss Hattie M. Miller, in the Patent Office as a skilled laborer, and the held text carries the annotation "Superseded Executive Order 1087, June 15, 1909." The permission in EO 1087 to reinstate her as a classified laborer therefore ended on 1909-06-21. The annotation is editorial; EO 1093 itself does not use the word.
